acceptanceCriteria: Spike defines which quantities are directly countable from existing local ledgers (packet bytes, planned versus unplanned reads, surprise) and which need a counterfactual, marking the latter NOT_OBSERVED.
If pursued: a read-only digest command or an observations section reports the countable quantities per session and range, with no new writer.
No savings figure is reported that is not derived from retained counts; the report is reviewed against V1-0369's unmatched-observation defect.
body: Source: GitHub trending review 2026-10-16 (idea only; nothing was adopted or measured). Prior art: xerj-org/xerj ships `xerj gain`, which reports what the tool saved, described as counted rather than estimated, and context-mode ships `ctx_stats`, which covers data avoided and cache hits. Corvint retains self-observations (`corvint observations`) and has cost gates in harness trials (V1-0369, V1-0742, V1-0777), but an operator has no direct report of what Corvint packets displaced in a real session: packet bytes delivered versus files the agent would otherwise read, and the files it read anyway (reads / unplanned-reads ledger). The report must abstain where a counterfactual cannot be observed, rather than invent a savings figure (invariant 2).
title: Idea: counted per-session context-savings report (bytes and tokens avoided, measured not estimated)
